reviews.text:
It's really not easy to get in. The first time is terrifying, having to wait hours in the tiny waiting room among the many dogs before someone gets in, and it's not even possible with many dogs. But if someone does, then wait your turn, come to the opening, preferably for a morning appointment. We did that and got in relatively quickly.

If we hadn't gotten here, my dog ​​would have died within weeks, now he's recovering. Before them, 8 vets gave him a false diagnosis, they wanted to cut off his toe unnecessarily, and they mistreated him for 5 years. I won't take my dog ​​anywhere else, that's for sure.

Every minute of waiting is worth it, because a competent, thorough team works there. Our puppy has never had a problem that they couldn't find a satisfying solution for. A professional team under the wings of Dr. Józsi!
We are extremely satisfied with them! Thank you for your conscientious work! ❤️

The best in the WORLD. Even if some of my pets are already running around up there.
Dr. József Varga and his team do the most amazing and hardest job in the world. Day after day. 🙏💫 …

It's open until all the animals there are provided with food and are overworked.
I have one observation: there is no zero in the machine, someone who is sugary and doesn't bring anything can't drink, it would be good to fix this.
Oh, sorry, there is water😂 but it would be good to serve some soft drinks too...

The best veterinarian in the country. You may have to wait a long time to get in line at the office, but it's worth it. We've been taking our small pets to him for 20 years. He's conscientious and his professional knowledge is excellent.
Dr. Varga is a very good specialist.

First of all - I can't comment on the care, because we didn't get in. In 2026, I think it would have been possible to move forward with no appointment bookings in any form, but at least that we would respect the care upon arrival (except for urgent cases, of course). We sat in the office for nearly 2 hours without a single employee asking if the animal was between life and death, or if we had just stopped by to rest because we had nothing better to do. In fact, one of the colleagues specifically looked past us, then went to the "familiar" dog, who arrived about an hour and a half after us. Incidentally, this also happened to about 4 other familiar patients, who seemed to have just come to visit neighbors, knocked, and then were treated (it was just a bandage, not an emergency). I am grateful for only one thing: that we had only come to vaccinate the kittens, and it was not a life-and-death situation. The doctors are certainly very good, but then they should close the door to new ones and keep the current patient population, don't convince us over the phone to go get vaccinated, because it's only 10 minutes anyway.
One of the best veterinarians in Budapest

I only regret that we didn't come here right away, Doctor Józsi, not only a world-class veterinarian and therapist, but also a HUMAN, according to some UFO people, in a good way of course, because the amount of sleep he gets in a week is what people usually get every day... He is in touch with every returning pet, and he does everything, literally, and money is not the first thing for him, as is typical unfortunately...
The entire staff is professional, kind, and cute, I would especially highlight Andi!
When I first heard about him, there was an article about the Cerberus shelter... I was moved to tears as a man... He did everything he could for the rescued dog, but it was too late...
He had to let go, the Doctor hated him with all his heart, but unfortunately there was no other chance... Can anyone show me a veterinarian... Who lies down next to the dog in the middle of the office and walks him across the rainbow bridge with a hug.... I will be forever grateful to Him, Them, and as long as I live they can count on me at any time ❤️
Negative commenters don't belong here..

We thank the best veterinary clinic in the world for everything. Our Dézik lived for 18 years, to which Doctor Józsi and his team contributed greatly. They were there until the end, helping in any way they could. We have only been coming here with our dogs for 20 years, even from Vienna. I wish our pets would live forever! And I wish the pet clinic on Család Street would exist forever!
They are dedicated professionals who heal with their hearts and souls, even if it were all that would help small animals fight various diseases.
If you want professional medical care for your little pet, you can count on a team of highly qualified professionals who will help you in safe hands. I can only recommend them.

I don't even know who answered the phone at one minute before 5 o'clock on Sunday, but I still think of him with immense gratitude. My cat is not his patient, not my acquaintance, but he listened to me and with his patient answers and calmness pulled me out of the panic that had been going on for days, which was caused by my cat's illness. He was right about everything, he healed the cat and me invisibly.
They are simply the best in the country!

This place is a disaster. It's 35 degrees and they can't even turn on the air conditioning, we're panting inside with the dogs. The assistance is beyond criticism. It's condescending and indoctrinating and you have to fight to be noticed as if you were at a bidding war. This level reminds me of the last run-down village veterinary clinic. I don't understand why this level is good, but it would be worth them going to Western countries for further training every month.
Gratitude and thanks for Csoki's 😼 recovery. 💝 …

I am aware that this opinion will not bring my cat back, and also that there are more urgent cases, priorities and difficult decisions in a veterinary clinic. This is not the first time I have had an elderly animal, so I know exactly how a clinic works and what responsibilities doctors have. Nevertheless, I find it unacceptable that my 15-year-old cat in serious condition had to wait from 9 am to 5 pm for an examination, while we had already indicated the previous evening that it was a serious problem.

However, the most painful thing is not this, but that during the examination on April 11 — where an ultrasound was also performed — my cat’s bilateral kidney tumors were not detected. The doctor suspected a urinary tract infection as the first diagnosis, and my cat received antibiotic treatment, while I now know in retrospect that a serious, cancerous disease was actually the underlying cause. We hoped and treated him for a month, while his condition continued to deteriorate.

Finally, on May 11, another veterinarian immediately noticed, just by touching, that both of his kidneys were significantly enlarged, and suspected a tumor, which was immediately confirmed by the next ultrasound. Within a short time, his condition deteriorated so rapidly that my cat finally had to be put down.

It is especially painful for me that, in addition to all this, we paid a total of about 150 thousand forints for treatments and examinations without the real problem being recognized. I am not writing this out of revenge, and not because I expect flawless treatment from anyone. But because perhaps other owners will ask for a second opinion in time if they feel that something is wrong.

To their answer: The “truth” then also includes the fact that the doctor did NOT personally tell me that my cat has a bilateral kidney tumor. No such diagnosis was made. Instead, he said, and I quote: “this is such a speculative disease,” and that he suspected a urinary tract infection, which is why my cat was given antibiotics.

So either they really didn’t recognize the tumor, or they did, but they didn’t communicate this to me — the owner — properly. Neither option is reassuring.

What is particularly outrageous to me, however, is that they are now trying to make the situation look like they had clearly communicated the serious disease to me and “couldn’t have come unexpectedly.” But yes, it did come unexpectedly. Precisely because the vet didn’t communicate Mázli’s condition as a tumor, but rather as a urinary tract problem.

There’s one thing I really hate in life: when someone tries to say something different afterwards than what was actually said. That’s why I ask that they at least not distort the facts of the communication in their response.

This won’t bring my cat back. But perhaps it can be a lesson for other owners that if something doesn't work out, they should dare to ask for a second opinion in a timely manner.
Everyone is very kind and knowledgeable. They go above and beyond. You may have to wait a long time, but it's worth it. Thank you for your humane attitude and maximum helpfulness.

Miracles happen here.❤️
Under the care of Dr. Józsi.❤️❤️

The doctor works very conscientiously, but they take on too many animals, they are overworked. One of the nurses was clearly overwhelmed and frustrated and couldn't take care of my sick animal. I had to take out the IV because my dog ​​had to go pee, and then when the nurse put the IV back in, she put it in the wrong way, and my dog's blood started flowing back through the IV. Despite this, they really work honestly, I think they just want to take on too many animals.

Doc and his team saved the life of my “Space Dinosaur” in 2021. Dió is an 11-year-old mixed breed dog, we were on a full-time senior general today. They dictate an amazing pace every single day, yet they do their job with immense love/dedication/exceptional expertise! I trust them blindly and would wait for them no matter how much, because I know they fight for every pet as if it were their own!❤️
Thank you for keeping us safe with you!

We came to Dr. József Varga with a miniature poodle, with whom we have been struggling with stomach problems for a long time. The doctor is currently treating our dog, and I can only say: hats off to him and the entire practice!
It is not by chance that the adjective “Wonder Doctor” stuck to him. He is like the Hungarian Dr. Dolittle – he really treats animals as if he understands their every move. 🐾
The people working in the practice are also incredibly kind and very knowledgeable, which means a lot in such situations.
However, it is important to emphasize that you should be prepared for a longer waiting time. This is not a place where you will be in line within an hour or two. However, anyone who comes here knows: quality care takes time. It is worth the wait, because the animal receives real attention and thorough treatment.
Overall, I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone looking for a conscientious and professional veterinarian.😊
I love you!

I have known veterinarian Dr. József Varga for a very long time. I am extremely satisfied, I can always say 100% that he is the best doctor in the country. His high level of knowledge saved my dog ​​Brutus. I took my dog ​​there feeling unwell with a stomach upset, and it turned out during the examination that he had spleen cancer and part of his intestines had already died. Doctor Józsi saved his life, this was 2 years ago. Great respect to the doctor and his team.
Bad manners, impatience, long waits, unreliability, extremely expensive.

Pluto the dog has been thanking us ever since, he is doing well 💕 along with his spleen, which the doctor wanted to remove with immediate effect back in July because the dog had “lymphoma”, we did not agree to this, after that we asked for a second and third opinion and they confirmed that the dog did NOT have lymphoma and we made the right decision! He has not taken any medication since then, because there was no need for it and there is no need for it…
I do not recommend this place! I can’t even imagine what would have happened if we had stayed there😨
They have no insurmountable case.

I AM FISHY!! This is the easiest way to express my experiences!
A week ago we came to Dr. Ur with my dog ​​Dobi (12). In other places they immediately recommended an endoscopy for the problem, but Dr. Ur rather treated the problem/s with a thorough examination. Dobi underwent surgery yesterday, successfully. They treated my “problematic” dog with great patience and consideration, despite the fact that they are terribly busy.
I think the knowledge and humility that Dr. Ur possesses is very rare in today's world and he goes out of his way to see everyone even outside of the appointment time!!!
The waiting time is indeed several hours, but for us it was worth every minute, because I think we were/are in the best possible hands and we will be in the future. We would like to thank Dr. Dobi and the staff there for their patience and support🙏🏽❤️🐾

Professionally, it's perfect, but having to spend 8-10 hours on an infusion treatment cycle is unsustainable, I would practically have to quit my job, and my child would only see me in a photo if I went here.
Professional expertise, state-of-the-art equipment, kind doctors and assistants. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic and its doctors after about 15 years.

The almost obsessive conscientiousness and love for animals are unquestionable, and I don't doubt the professional competence, but for me, the fact that they recommend homeopathic remedies for dog allergies discredits a lot. In addition, the continuous, chaotic chaos experienced in the waiting room detracts a lot from the value of the practice.

A completely special, dedicated team, with special attention to the animals (sometimes also to the owners), provides help. I admire the tireless dedication and expertise with which the people working there help the animals.

A ganz besonderes, engagittes Team leistet Hilfe und kümmert sich mit außergewöhnlicher Aufmerkung um die Tiere (nicht selten auch um deren Besitzer). Mit Bewunderung sehe ich die unermüdliche Hingabe und Fachkompetenz, mit der die dort Arbeitenden den Tieren helfen.

Yes, you have to wait a long time, as is usually the case with good things...
It's worth the wait.

Yes, you have to wait a lot.. so this is not even waiting, but starting on the path to recovery!!!
Every minute we get closer to ACCURATE DIAGNOSIS, and then with the new expectations we take the necessary steps to HEALING.
So I wish everyone successful 'steps' and the shortest 'path' to recovery :) What is certain is that the DOCTOR WILL DO EVERYTHING!!!
Thank you for everything Józsi!!!
Palkó tacsi ;)
Thorough, kind, great professionals
It was the best choice to come here. No matter how long the wait, the care and thoroughness we receive here is worth it! Thank you!
They saved our dog's life with emergency life-saving surgery. We are so grateful. We are the reason there is a long wait.
I've never met such a dedicated veterinarian. His work ethic is incredible. Do I have to wait a long time? Yes, but I knew where I was coming from, and no pet is left unattended here. Thank you, doc!

The Doctor is a miracle! He saved our dying dog! ❤️ No appointment, probably have to wait, but... we won't take our dogs anywhere else! Our dog was seen by 3 doctors before him, several doctors, but they didn't know what was wrong since last December. Our dog is now in a terrible condition, he was saved here!

I would only come here next time I have a tumor to see Dr Józsi Varga. It is no coincidence that he is called the "miracle doctor".
You just have to be prepared for a very long wait (2-3 hours minimum, but even until the early hours of the morning) and sometimes you may need to repeatedly signal your presence because the doctors are very focused on the animals and there is no one left to deal with logistics. I considered this the price of the "miracle doctor".

Not only nationally, but worldwide, there is no other such wonderful veterinarian who treats animals on such a selfless level and even has consideration for their owners. He has no opening hours, only animals in need of care are closed. He sacrifices his own life to his profession, to fight for the cure of animals until the last moment.
If I am not there, I do not believe that there is such self-sacrifice for a profession. You have to wait a lot, but this thorough and conscientious care was not a problem for me. The point is not how long I wait, but what kind of care my dog ​​receives, and it is the best here in the whole country. There are many mistreated animals here, from all over the country, from abroad, for whom Józsi is their last chance. We came to him from England as a last chance, and I owe him and his team an unspeakable gratitude for fighting so much for my little furry child, Suzy.
May God bless you Józsi with strength, health and love, so that you can be here as a doctor and savior of our animals for a very long time.
A thousand thanks and gratitude to you!!!!!
It looks like my cat was saved by Dr. Varga and his team. It was terribly crowded, but that's understandable since he's well-known.
The best veterinary clinic we have ever been to, it is true that you have to wait a long time, but that is because every animal is examined and cared for very thoroughly and conscientiously.

An assistant came out once in 2 and a half hours, it was impossible to keep track of who arrived after whom. We were not given any information about how long we had to wait or why the line had been standing for hours. We finally left. I would not recommend it to anyone, a waste of time
We've been with you for 20 years, no matter where we've moved. Thank you for your work, the passion you have for your work, and the love you feel and radiate for animals. 🥰 …

We arrived at the office as new clients with an acute problem in the morning when it opened, and they took everyone who knocked on our door with some excuse before us. They knew we had been waiting there for 2 hours, and two hours later a new client came in who they took first. I would NOT recommend the office to anyone, we had to go elsewhere with our problem, but the whole morning was gone.

I've been waiting for 4 hours for someone to examine my kidney-ill cat, who hasn't eaten for a week. Many of the kissers who came after me have already left. A female individual came out first, with the question: "So, is the head separated from the body yet?"
This behavior is not allowed anywhere!
I fill out the papers for the examination of the cat, which they brought in, but not the cat.
I ask, when did this clinic change like this?

Professionally and humanly impeccable. They treated my dog ​​nicely. They explained everything clearly, which is very important. Not a pushy, conveyor belt place!
I recommend it🎀 …

Dear Doctor Józsi! I am one of the lucky ones who got to know you through your family. Despite this, you never made any exceptions. All animals are the same with you. My little Friciki passed away yesterday. If it weren't for you, he wouldn't have lived nearly 20 years. Thank you for everything. My precious little boy passed away yesterday. Thank you for everything! I would never take my child anywhere else!

My daughter took her little Chihuahua to Budapest today and she received such thorough care that she couldn't get anywhere else! Even though we called several clinics in Debrecen for a heart ultrasound! Thank you to the entire staff, again ❤️ I strongly recommend them to everyone!

We arrived on Monday morning because I was told by phone that although there were no appointments, they were usually the least busy at that time.

There were indeed few people, but for a long time there was almost no progress, so we gave up and left.
At least one assistant could have asked for our papers, asked what the hell we were doing there, or given us information about why we were not making any progress and how long we would have to wait.

The waiting room was scorching hot, although there was air conditioning, it was not turned on. There was a planned power outage of a few minutes, they said they would turn it on later, but nothing happened. Panting, overheated dogs and cats drying out in carriers were waiting for their fate.

Meanwhile, people who had been to the clinic before arrived for appointments, so appointments do exist, they just like to torture first-time visitors a bit. Very great attitude, congratulations! I don't know why it's so hard to start using a calendar. Anyway, we definitely won't be coming here again, and I don't recommend it to anyone who doesn't want to torture their pet in the heat for hours.
There are no words for the love, humility, professionalism, and high level of education they have in the field of animal healing. A wonderful team with wonderful doctors and wonderful people.
The best veterinarian in the world; along with his team.

The most amazing Doctor and his team, one by one. Unfortunately, I have had the good fortune to sit and wait for 8-9 hours twice (that's all for me) but they finish the order that lasts until 5:20 pm at 7 am the next morning and they never take care of animals because Józsi simply can't say no after so many hours, the animal comes first for him. I thank you for being there every day of the week, even on holidays. And hats off to you for being able to do this with such spiritual knowledge. In addition to the bad comments, I also need a lot of patience from the owners. And yes, we "only wait 5-8 hours (an urgent operation may come in) but they may be in there for almost 24 hours, it would be good if everyone took this into account. Thank you for your work, you are incredible.

Many thanks to József Varga and his team for the conscientious and comprehensive examinations of Koni, for the infusion, and for the work done with superhuman professionalism. We wish you all a lot of strength and good health.🐕🤗 …

I do not recommend it! Today we went with an injured dog, 17 years old, in life-threatening condition! The ‘doctor’ did not accept him, because there were 6 other dogs waiting for vaccinations in front of us. Such a person should not call himself a doctor! By the way, the owners there let us go in front of them, and the assistant ‘lady’ did not let us go with priority, then shrugged her shoulders at the sentence: that our dog would die. Fortunately, he was treated in another clinic, he is out of danger, otherwise they can be happy about that, because I would sue the pants off them! For us, dogs are family members and it is a shame that such people work there! 👎🏻

And I would respond to the answer by saying: ‘the doctor is currently working so we don’t know when they will be able to get their turn’ or ‘they should wait their turn, they can’t come in and shrug their shoulders’ - there’s a big difference… I believe everything, they produced a great answer - that’s why the communication was still what it was, so it doesn’t change my opinion!
Best sleep doctor!

Dr. József Varga is the most conscientious, most tidy veterinarian I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. I can only recommend him to everyone, together with the Doctor, the assistant ladies are also so humane and dedicated to helping every animal that there are no words for it.
I will always be grateful to them!
He saved the life of my furry little boy, Nózi...along with Dr. Anna...I will be forever grateful. ❤️
A legprofibbak!
It takes a lot of patience. It's a full day program.

I hope they will get back at least a thousand times what they do for the animals! Here you can really feel that what they do is a profession, and despite being overloaded, they are always kind and inform the owners.
After many doctors, this is the only place where our cat was examined normally, we are forever grateful to all the workers, it's a miracle!

Horrible place. We tried to bring our pet here because the place we usually take them to wasn't booked. QR code check-in was successful. We were the only ones in the waiting room, after an hour and a half of waiting my partner called and mentioned that nothing was happening. All we could hear from behind the door was them laughing loudly about this and saying to each other: tell me it's another 5 hours of waiting, at this moment I got up and came. Calling our vet with the story, he opened the office and treated the animal. The approach is a bit different….

I have had four dogs so far, and now I have a fifth, whom I adopted when he was 9 years old. He was in a pretty miserable condition, but Dr. Józsi fixed him up really nicely. His diet is free of poultry because he is allergic. He eats his own food, I cook for him on the doctor's recommendation. He has been doing this for 4 years now, and it's working great. It turned out that his kidneys are a little bad, so we had to take him off protein, he can only get a minimum amount. The doctor gave me all the advice that is worth considering in such cases. I have never taken any of my dogs to anyone, because I trust only him. It's true that I am already retired, but when I was working, I waited my turn patiently.....because it was worth it. Thank you for the help so far, Dr. Józsi, I hope I will have a few more years with Bubu.

Doctor József Varga and his team are fantastic! 😍 They are committed at every level. They do everything they can for the animals. I also ask everyone who loves animals to support them, whether it's with 1% of your tax or by returning used bottles. Thank you on their behalf! …

We waited for seven hours……. With a sick dog, it was already excruciating for me, not to mention my dog…. And if that wasn’t enough, they were terribly rude…. I went with the complaint that my dog ​​was coughing and had difficulty …

I waited almost 8 hours for my dog ​​to be examined and there weren't many people in front of me. This is outrageous for both the dog and the owner. There is suffering and huge charges here. The doctor also performs tests that are not …

Dear Andris, Owner! While waiting for what you thought was a 10-minute tick removal "stunt", you must have noticed that this is not the kind of place where some owners bring their Fifike in for an appointment and then go home without …

Yesterday we arrived from Sopron for a check-up with Kókus, where unfortunately a serious tumor was found that required immediate intervention. Doctor Mr. and Doctor Anna Hatvani acted immediately and removed the tumor, saving Kókus's life! …
Fantastic doctors take care of sick animals.

I arrived at the opening, filled out the QR code registration by phone. There was 1 person in front of me. I waited 2 hours to get a tick removed, then after 2 hours of waiting I came home because I couldn't get in line.... I don't recommend it to anyone who has money and can't wait half a day for a 10-minute show. ✌🏼✌🏼 …

I called Dr. József Varga on Saturday afternoon, he answered the phone right away and gave me very kind advice! (I have never met a veterinarian who answered the phone on Saturday afternoon and was so understanding) 4 days later we took the …

The doctors are excellent, very thorough... so bring cold food with you, because you might be here for 3 or even 6 hours. There is a vending machine for hunger and thirst: coffee, some soft drinks and snacks, and a bag of croissants. For that, a special thank you!

Cute place, for owners
For dogs too
The doctor and his entire team are amazing. They have been willing to help us save all our animals so far and the neutering of the kittens went smoothly. You can ask, they will help. …
It's been three weeks since we got a week, even at best, from anyone else!

Dr. Varga and his team are brilliant🥰
Long wait time, but it really doesn't matter. Our puppy was safe, there was a thorough examination, and everything was explained in a reassuring way.
We are grateful🙏🥰 …
The best, truly conscientious, helpful veterinary team! The wait is constant, but you have to be aware of that. However, it is worth every moment spent waiting!
A great team, both professionally and personally! They are truly there to save and help our pets, and they often see many patients outside of office hours.
More than a Pet Clinic. This is a MIRACLE FOR us and our sick animals.
Extraordinary medical team, excellent care! They do their job with heart, soul and dedication. Hats off. If I had a problem, I would actually go to their country rather than a human hospital..

The best I've ever seen
They saved my cat Mázli❤️❤️❤️

Dr. Varga Jozsef cured my greyhound 3 years ago and thanks to his advices we were able to live together despite a strong autoimmune disease. In an hour he diagnosed the autoimmune disease that the university was unable to diagnose even …

I can only write good things, Dr. Jozsi and his team are the best
Thank you❤️🐾🐾🙏🏻 …

Very good care. True animal lovers. Everything went well. We are 1000 percent satisfied. They saved the cat's life. We are grateful for that from Párkany. We will only go here. We recommend it to everyone.

I went at 7:30 in the evening, we came back at 1:30. Everyone's heads were already hanging down, we were so tired, but he still examined Bijou anyway, for 1.5 - 2 hours. He immediately ruled out radiation treatment!! Perseverance to you, and sometimes rest too!!!!
Very high quality precise animal clinic. Doctor Józsi Varga is very knowledgeable and of course his medical team is also excellent. …
What can I say....Doc Józsi...and his team are the best...

Doc Józsi is the best.
You have to wait a long time for him, that's a fact.
But he finds out what's wrong with the little one. …

I am incredibly grateful to Dr. Józsi and his team. Dr. Józsi is a miracle doctor🥰we took our dog there in a very bad condition (due to another doctor's mistake) but he fixed him in a week. I will be forever grateful to him for saving our …
The best
The knowledge and dedication of the doctors can only be spoken of in high terms. They are able to work 20 hours a day if the situation requires it.

Boundless dedication, and as far as I can tell, the highest level of professional knowledge is concentrated here! I, my family, and Tóbiás, our dachshund who had spinal surgery, are grateful for everything!
❤️❤️❤️ just as amazing as always! Thank you! ❤️❤️❤️
